corrections.subject: fix(agent-environment): never let the child configuration stand in for the explicit request

corrections.notes: childConfiguration(configuration, request) has no default; the configuration may only agree. Scripted js-debug tests check the command the child receives for attach and launch, and that a missing, unknown, disagreeing or configuration-only request opens no child session. Mutants checked by hand: configure(next, "launch", ...) and kind = arguments.request ?? "launch" both fail the new test.
